How it works

Live Grill in four steps.

You decide what goes on your plate. Our chefs take care of the rest – freshly cooked in front of you.

Take your table number

Bring the clip with your table number to the Live Grill buffet.

Choose your ingredients

Create your plate with meat, fish, seafood and vegetables.

Choose your sauce

Attach the clip with your table number to your plate and add your chosen sauce.

Enjoy it fresh

Our chefs cook everything on the teppanyaki grill and serve your dish hot.

Your visit to Phönix

Frequently asked questions.

Buffet hours, reservations and parking in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg at a glance.

When is the restaurant open?

Phönix Chinese Restaurant at Mühlenberg-Center is open daily from 12:00 to 23:00.

When is the Live Grill buffet available?

The Live Grill buffet is available Tuesday to Friday from 17:30 to 22:00, and on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays from 12:00 to 22:00. On Mondays outside public holidays, the evening buffet is served without Live Grill.

How can I reserve a table?

We accept reservations by phone only. Call 030 467 93 187 to book your table.

Can I park for free at the restaurant?

Yes. The first 90 minutes at the Mühlenberg-Center car park are free. For public transport and parking details, see Directions & contact.
